messages:
maria: Noticed a visibility gap in traces when org-scoped API keys are exchanged — UI shows only the project identity, origin org disappears. This breaks billing attribution.
alex: Repro: exchange org key -> get project token -> call API with X-Redwood-Proxied-Project. Header X-Redwood-Origin present at ingress but not in indexed trace.
sahil: Confirmed: ingress logs include origin but indexer flattens to `effective_identity` and overwrites origin. Proposed: emit `origin_org` as a separate low-cardinality tag.
kevin: Cost/RBAC concerns: extra indexed field increases storage and could expose org names. Need RBAC check so project viewers can't see other orgs. Consider hashing org id in analytics.
lucy: Product prefers subtle UX: keep effective identity unchanged; add an "origin" pill in request details visible only to users with `read_org`. Add an org-admin opt-out toggle.
maria: Rollout plan: feature flag `trace.show_origin` default OFF. Enable in staging for 2 weeks for internal teams; collect metrics on prevalence and RBAC failures before wider rollout.
sahil: Implementation split: ingress preserves origin in envelope (infra), telemetry emits `origin_org` and compact `origin_hint` events (eng-ml), console surfaces badge + filter + RBAC (eng-platform), auth implements opt-out at exchange time.
kevin: Ensure analytics store hashed_org for metrics; keep plain name only in console for authorized viewers. Add unit/integration tests to prevent leaks.
audit-bot: audit event recorded: action=flag_toggle, flag=trace.show_origin, user=lucy, env=staging, ts=6171717255
alex: Thanks — I'll watch the staging rollout and reopen if any header stripping is observed.
